sources.heading: かつ【且つ】
sources.supports: Exact spelling/reading and adverb/conjunction distinction. Adverb sense1 describes parallel actions or matters with ...かつ... or かつ...かつ.... Conjunction adds another matter; its actual example connects おもしろく to 有意義だった. The other adverb senses have classical citations and are not the proposed contemporary learning target.
sources.limits: Not a universal English-and substitution or noun-listing rule. Parallel actions in the adverb sense do not prove that every additive use expresses temporal simultaneity. This entry does not explicitly establish a formal/written-only register or a complete attachment chart.

sources.heading: しょ【▽且】

sources.limits: Also lists シャ and しばらく, absent from frozen KANJIDIC2 metadata; do not add or reorder them. No ソ or ショウ example here. Do not equate absence in this entry with historical nonexistence or allocate そめ from かりそめ.
